newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Portland, Ore..

text.p: Sewer System Revenue Bonds, 1996 Series A
The City of Portland, Oregon intends to receive sealed bids for the above referenced series of Sewer System Revenue Bonds (the Bonds'') until 10:00 a.m., Pacific time, on
at the Office of Finance and Administration of the City Room 1250, 1120 S.W. 5th Avenue, Portland, Oregon 97204.

The Bonds will be dated November 1, 1996 and will mature in the approximate principal amounts set forth in the full Notice of Sale on June 1 of the years 1998 through 2017, inclusive. The City has reserved the right to adjust the principal amount of each maturity during the business day following receipt of bids to adjust annual debt service; notice of any adjustment will be promptly given to the successful bidder. The winning bidder may designate two or more consecutive maturities of Bonds as term bonds in an aggregate principal amount equal to the sum of the principal amounts of its consecutive maturities. Each term bond shall mature on the final maturity date of its consecutive maturities and shall be subject to mandatory redemption at a price of par and by lot in the amounts and on the dates which would have been consecutive maturities. All or any portion of the Bonds then outstanding are subject to optional redemption prior to maturity on any date on and after June 1, 2006 at a price of par, plus accrued but unpaid interest to the date fixed for redemption. The City has reserved the right to specify the particular maturities and the aggregate principal amount of each maturity to be called for optional redemption if less than all then outstanding Bonds are called, at any time or from time to time, for optional redemption. Certain interest rate
constraints affecting bids are set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be issued in Book-Entry form only.
Unless the City rejects any or all bids received, the Bonds will be awarded to the bidder whose bid offers the lowest true interest cost to the City.

The Preliminary Official Statement which contains the full Notice of Sale and optional bid form may be obtained from the City's Office of Finance and Administration, Room 1250, 1120 S.W. 5th Avenue, Portland, Oregon 97204, Attention: Mr. Eric Johansen, (503) 823-6851.
